audit_items.proof_trace: ClearStorage creates/retains empty PerContractState in _storages (line 438) but never removes it. The only removal path (line 225) requires address in toUpdateRoots AND non-existent account, but ClearStorage removes from toUpdateRoots (line 436), preventing cleanup.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Repeatedly deploy contract, populate storage, then SELFDESTRUCT or clear storage. Each cycle leaks PerContractState object in _storages dictionary. Over thousands of cycles (e.g., CREATE2 griefing attack), accumulates unbounded memory causing node resource exhaustion.
